# Agent Booster

> Mechanical code edits without a model: deterministic, free, offline. Agent Booster (`agent-booster`) strips console calls, turns var and let into const, sorts imports, wraps async functions in try/catch, adds debug logging and adds "use strict", with regex transforms that cost nothing and give the same output every time. It ships a CLI (`agent-booster`), an MCP server (`agent-booster-mcp`, one tool per transform), skills and a Claude Code plugin, and it improves itself through its own evals.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): what it does, every command and MCP tool, the editing rules, what not to do
- [README.md](README.md): overview, one-step install for every coding agent, quick start

## Skills

- [route-the-boring-path](skills/route-the-boring-path/SKILL.md): route the mechanical part of an edit to a free transform before spending model tokens
- [sandbox-untrusted-transform](skills/sandbox-untrusted-transform/SKILL.md): transform untrusted code inside an E2B microVM
- [add-a-transform](skills/add-a-transform/SKILL.md): add a new transform to Agent Booster correctly

## MCP tools

- [MCP server source](src/mcp-server.ts): six tools over stdio: transform_var_to_const, transform_remove_console, transform_add_logging, transform_add_error_handling, transform_format_imports, transform_add_strict; each takes {"code": "..."}
- [Plugin manifest](.claude-plugin/plugin.json): the Claude Code plugin (skills, sub-agents, hook, MCP server)
- [Gemini CLI extension](gemini-extension.json): context and MCP server for Gemini CLI
- [A2A agent card](.well-known/agent-card.json): name, description, skills
